summary: chore(content-server): delete the Backbone client app
description:
Because:

- The React app serves every content-server page, so the Backbone client app had no use.

This commit:

- Deletes the Backbone app, its tests, webpack config and client l10n grunt tasks.
- Replaces the react-app route classes with a small reactRouteServer.
- Updates the package.json scripts that used the client bundle.
- Makes the l10n grunt tasks read only server.pot.

Closes FXA-14816
